evidence_notes: GPT-6 Astra edits pi0.5 via a persistent CPU Python kernel plus a budgeted simulator forward tool (p2), so closed-loop and tool-mediated. The authors state the full 765-pair evaluation is not 'a preregistered independent replication' (p2); held-out split fixed by SHA-256 parity but no registry. Matched-norm random-direction control and mechanical full destination replacement (90.5% vs 92.0%) are reported (p4); LoRA and prompt rewriting not measured (p8); public code/weights 'will be supplied' (p8); API cost accounting not available (p8); 12 of 13 non-language sessions declined or reverted (p6-7).
